name: IAU CCSIT answer sheet (legacy, landscape A4, no fiducials)
provenance: Bubble lattice reconstructed from 143 scanned sheets by multi-scale ring detection, registration (pitch similarity, low-resolution correlation, ICP to a quadratic warp) and consensus clustering; fields assigned from the printed topology. Coordinates are pixels at 200 dpi in the frame of blank-200dpi.png, a median reconstruction of the printed form with every bubble replaced by its unfilled appearance. Contains no student data.
completed_points_note: points completed from the lattice where the ring was hidden on almost every sheet
